title: Initial work-tape contents
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. In the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$, for every work tape $h$ and every integer offset $d$ from its head, the scanned cell contains no symbol.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$h$ is a work-tape index among the $k$ tapes
